stop_rules.note: a 429 is waited out with a doubling pause and the same request is asked again; three in a row end the run; no other address, no proxy, no retry around a refusal

purpose: GASCYCLE zero-try count (Idea Desk C, owner MAIN): historical settled market lists of the Ohio and Indiana daily gas series (markets closed before Kalshi's history boundary, about 2026-09-13). No candle, no price field read.
heldout: This endpoint takes no date bound; it holds only markets closed before the history boundary (about 2026-09-13), which is before GASCYCLE's held-out start (2026-10-15). FOR AUDITOR B AND THE HEAD TO RULE: run it only if that boundary is accepted as the bound. The reader drops any row with close_time at or after 2026-10-15T00:00:00Z unopened (there should be none) and keeps only ticker, event_ticker, close_time, strike fields, expiration_value and result.
notes: Two series, the historical list each, up to 12 pages of 1,000. At most 24 pages, cap 26. Needed only if the series began before about 2026-09-13; if GASCYCLE_COUNT_LIVE shows the first event after that, this job is not run.
